changeSet.sql: if (OBJECT_ID('[security].[Role]') > 0 and OBJECT_ID('dbo.ResponsibilityType') > 0) begin IF exists(select 1 from [security].[Role]) begin set identity_insert [security].[Role] on; merge into [security].[Role] as r using (select ID, Uid, Name, Description, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityType) rt on (r.id = rt.id) when matched Then update set Name = rt.Name, Description = rt.Description, [Permissions] = 1, [UpdatedBy] = rt.UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn = rt.UpdatedOn when not matched then insert (ID, Uid, Name, Description, [Permissions], CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) values (rt.ID, rt.Uid, rt.Name, rt.Description, 1, rt.CreatedBy, rt.CreatedOn, rt.UpdatedBy, rt.UpdatedOn); set identity_insert [security].[Role] off; end else begin set identity_insert [security].[Role] on; insert into [security].[Role] (ID, Uid, Name, Description, [Permissions], CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) select ID, Uid, Name, Description, 1, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityType; set identity_insert [security].[Role] off; end end

changeSet.author: Pappas
changeSet.sql:
if (OBJECT_ID('[security].[Rule]') > 0 and OBJECT_ID('dbo.ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule') > 0) begin if exists (select 1 from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule) begin set identity_insert [security].[Rule] on; merge into [security].[Rule] as r using ( select r.ID, r.Uid, r.Name, r.ResponsibilityTypeID, 2 as SecurityType, a.ID as AssetTypeId, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, r.CreatedBy, r.CreatedOn, r.UpdatedBy, r.UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r left join AssetType a on a.Object = r.Object and a.ObjectID = r.ObjectID ) rtr on (r.id = rtr.id) when matched Then update set Name = rtr.Name, RoleID = rtr.ResponsibilityTypeID, [SecurityType] = 2, AssetTypeId = rtr.AssetTypeId, ApplyToType = rtr.ApplyToType, IsVisible = rtr.IsVisible, [UpdatedBy] = rtr.UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn = rtr.UpdatedOn when not matched then insert (ID, Uid, Name, RoleID, SecurityType, AssetTypeId, ApplyToType, IsVisible, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) values (rtr.ID, rtr.Uid, rtr.Name, rtr.ResponsibilityTypeID, 2, rtr.AssetTypeId, rtr.ApplyToType, rtr.IsVisible, rtr.CreatedBy, rtr.CreatedOn, rtr.UpdatedBy, rtr.UpdatedOn); set identity_insert [security].[Rule] off; end else begin set identity_insert [security].[Rule] on; insert into [security].[Rule] (ID, Uid, Name, RoleID, SecurityType, AssetTypeId, ApplyToType, IsVisible, CreatedBy, CreatedOn, UpdatedBy, UpdatedOn) select r.ID, r.Uid, r.Name, r.ResponsibilityTypeID, 2 as SecurityType, a.ID as AssetTypeId, r.ApplyToType, r.IsVisible, r.CreatedBy, r.CreatedOn, r.UpdatedBy, r.UpdatedOn from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r left join AssetType a on a.Object = r.Object and a.ObjectID = r.ObjectID; set identity_insert [security].[Rule] off; end
-- Set the security type ( [G]roup OR [U]ser ) update t set t.SecurityType = s.SecurityType from [security].[Rule] t inner join ( select r.ID, iif(sec.[Object] = 'GroupType', 1, 2) as SecurityType from ResponsibilityTypeRelationRule r cross apply openjson(r.Definition) with ( [Then] nvarchar(max) as json ) d cross apply openjson(d.[Then]) with ( Object varchar(50) ) sec ) s on s.ID = t.Id; end
